blurb:
This private party bus accommodates up to 30 passengers and lets you party for a cause! Upstage Party Bus has teamed up with The Grunt Style Foundation to support veterans through Military Transition & Sustainment, Food Insecurity, and Housing.

Climb aboard the largest open-air coach bus in Nashville — and the largest in the world! Whether you’re dancing the night away or soaking in the sights, our air-ride suspension ensures a smooth, comfortable ride.

Experience the ultimate party vibe with our QSC concert sound system, eight programmed lights, fog machine, and eight TVs — bringing the energy of a front-row concert with every song.

Ages 21+ only.

We’re also the only Nashville party bus with onboard refrigeration and drink sales!
